remarks: Enjoy resort like lifestyle at Rolling Ridge, still one of the most desirable condo communities in Norwalk, nestled on park like grounds complete with pool, tranquil pond & paddle tennis. This spacious (956 sq. ft. top floor) one bedroom, 1.5 bath condo is nicely maintained with newer carpet, kitchen flooring and refreshed baths. Open spacious living room/dining area with sliders to private deck overlooks tranquil woodlands. BONUS: den or at home office with powder room (please note that den cannot be used as sleeping area as per association by-laws). Spacious primary bedroom with full bath and large walk-in closet. Monthly HOA include heat and hot and cold water, plenty of visitors parking, washer and dryer in unit. Large (7x7) private storage room in building across the driveway. Just minutes away from shopping, transportation and schools and within easy walking distance to popular Main Street restaurants. Agents please see agent remarks regarding common charges breakdown and special assessment.
